summary: Tested the Apple 5.1.1 guest-access fix end-to-end (backend + frontend). 26/26 new pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_guest_access.py covering: (a) the 4 read endpoints now allow guests (no Authorization header) — GET /videos, /users/{id}, /users/{id}/videos, /users/search?q=ni, /videos/{id} all return 200 with valid payloads; (b) gated endpoints still 401 for guests — /videos/{id}/stream-url, /videos/{id}/comments (GET+POST), /videos/{id}/like, /users/{id}/follow, /videos/upload-url; (c) logged-in (appletest) regression — /auth/login, /auth/me, /videos, /videos/{id}, /videos/{id}/comments, /users/{id}, /users/{id}/videos all 200; stream-url returns a presigned URL (subscriber); (d) no 5xx anywhere on the touched paths. Frontend (Expo web preview, mobile viewport 390x844): GUEST flow verified — app opens to /(tabs)/home (NEVER /login), Discover feed renders video cards, Profile/Upload/Following tabs show the new SignInWall (testID=signin-wall) with the exact required copy, /video/{id} shows the 'Sign in to watch' overlay (testID=video-signin-overlay) and skips the stream-url fetch, /user/{id} loads a creator's public profile + their clips, /search loads without redirect. LOGGED-IN regression — after sign-in, Profile shows the user's data (no wall), Upload pick button is present, Following header renders, settings gear works, and /video/{id} loads the player WITHOUT the overlay. RCA + fix applied: I caught a regression in /app/frontend/app/video/[id].tsx — the stream-url useEffect was guarded with `if (!id || !user) return` but `user` was NOT in the dependency array (`[id, router]`). When the page mounts before auth hydration finishes, the effect runs once with user=null, exits early, and never re-runs — so the player never gets a stream URL and the video can't play even for valid subscribers. Confirmed via backend logs (no /stream-url request seen) and a network listener (0 stream-url calls). Added `user` to the deps; after the fix, stream-url is called and the <video> element has src loaded (srcLen=402, readyState progressing). Verified post-fix in a fresh login session. All guest tests and the logged-in regression now pass.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by tester. useEffect at lines 64-90 now correctly includes `user` in its dependency array (was [id, router], now [id, user, router]). Without this fix, a logged-in user opening /video/{id} immediately after sign-in (before tokenStorage hydrates the user) would see no video — the effect early-exits on user=null and never re-runs.

rca_of_issue: Regression in /app/frontend/app/video/[id].tsx introduced by this PR. The new guest-skip guard `if (!id || !user) return;` was added to the stream-url useEffect, but the dependency array was left as `[id, router]`. React only re-runs effects when a dependency changes. When a logged-in user navigates to /video/{id} immediately after sign-in (common), the AuthProvider has not yet hydrated `user` from tokenStorage — so the effect runs with user=null, hits the guard, exits. Once user is hydrated React does not re-run the effect (user is not in deps), so the stream URL is never fetched and the <video> element stays empty. Reproduction: log in -> navigate to /video/{id} -> observe no /api/videos/{id}/stream-url request in backend logs and <video>.src remains empty for >20s. Mitigation (applied): change deps to `[id, user, router]`. After the fix, stream-url is called and the player loads (verified with a network listener and DOM polling — srcLen=402, readyState advancing).
